name: ballerina/data.yaml
description: The Ballerina data.yaml library provides robust and flexible functionalities for working with YAML data within

typeDefs.name: YAMLSchema
typeDefs.description: Represents the YAML schema available for the parser.

typeDefs.name: Options
typeDefs.description: Represent the options that can be used for filtering in the projection.

type.name: record {|boolean nilAsOptionalField; boolean absentAsNilableType; boolean enableYamlStreamReorder; anydata...;|}|false

fields.name: enableConstraintValidation
fields.description: enableConstraintValidation - Enable or disable constraint validation

typeDefs.name: WriteConfig
typeDefs.description: Configurations for writing a YAML document.

fields.name: indentationPolicy
fields.description: indentationPolicy - Number of whitespace for an indentation

fields.name: blockLevel
fields.description: blockLevel - The maximum depth level for a block collection

fields.name: canonical
fields.description: canonical - If set, the tags are written along with the nodes

fields.name: useSingleQuotes
fields.description: useSingleQuotes - If set, single quotes are used to surround scalars

fields.name: forceQuotes
fields.description: forceQuotes - If set, all the scalars are surrounded by quotes

fields.name: schema
fields.description: schema - YAML schema used for writing

fields.name: isStream
fields.description: isStream - If set, the parser will write a stream of YAML documents

fields.name: flowStyle
fields.description: flowStyle - If set, mappings and sequences will output in flow style

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description:
Represents the error type of the ballerina/data.yaml module. This error type represents any error that can occur
during the execution of data.yaml APIs.

typeDefs.name: NameConfig
typeDefs.description: Defines the name of the JSON Object key.

fields.name: value
fields.description: value - The name of the JSON Object key

functions.name: parseString

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description: On success, returns the given target type value, else returns an `yaml:Error`

functions.name: parseStream

parameters.name: options

functions.name: toYamlString
functions.description:
Converts anydata YAML value to a string.

```ballerina
yaml:toYamlString({"name": "Ballerina"}) ⇒ "name: Ballerina"
```

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Options used to get desired toString representation

return.description: On success, returns to string value, else returns an `yaml:Error`
